faq.q: What is the best alternative to Apple Journal?
faq.a: It depends on what you're missing. For an AI that talks with you, remembers you and writes a meditation from your day, Auserene (iPhone only). For a long archive on every device with optional AI, Day One. For a cheap AI coach on Android and the web too, Reflection. For a private diary with a one-time price, Diarium. For meditation and routines, Stoic.

A little. Journaling Suggestions use on-device processing to suggest moments to write about, and on iOS 27, Writing Prompts with Apple Intelligence suggest prompts based on what you write, on an iPhone 15 Pro or later. Apple's Journal guide doesn't describe any chat, summaries or memory of past entries.

faq.q: Is there an Apple Journal alternative with AI?
faq.a: Yes. Auserene, Day One (Gold plan), Rosebud, Reflection, Mindsera and Stoic all use AI to respond to your entries. Auserene and Day One turn a conversation into the entry; Reflection and Rosebud coach and review; Mindsera analyzes.

faq.q: Is Apple Journal better than Day One?
faq.a: Apple Journal is free, simpler and end-to-end encrypted by default. Day One costs money for more than one device but runs on Android, Windows and the web, holds more media per entry, and adds AI chat on its Gold plan. Day One can import your Apple Journal entries.

faq.q: Is Apple Journal available on Android or Mac?
faq.a: It's on the Mac since macOS Tahoe 26, and syncs with iPhone and iPad through iCloud. It isn't available on Android, Windows or the web.

Apple says that with default two-factor authentication and a passcode, all Journal entries are end-to-end encrypted in iCloud, so even Apple can't read them, and that Journaling Suggestions are processed on your device.

informationGain: A November 19, 2026 comparison built from Apple's current iOS 27 and macOS 27 guides, showing that Apple Journal now runs on the Mac, adds Apple Intelligence Writing Prompts only on iPhone 15 Pro or later, and transcribes voice in English only, set against eight alternatives whose facts each link to the company's own page.
